## Human verification and AI disclosure

Autonomous or unreviewed AI-agent pull requests are not accepted and may be
closed without review. See the
[Human-in-the-loop policy](https://github.com/c2g-dev/city2graph/blob/main/docs/contributing.md#human-in-the-loop-policy-and-ai-assisted-contributions).

- [ ] I am a human contributor who has personally read, understood, and verified every changed line in this pull request.
- [ ] I ran `uv run pytest -q` and `uv run pre-commit run --all-files` locally in the full development environment (`uv sync --extra cpu --group dev`), and both passed.
- [ ] This pull request is not part of an automated or uncoordinated bulk submission, and I can respond to technical review questions in my own words.
